Jay Dyer writes and lectures on film, symbolism, and secret societies. He joins Tucker Carlson for a sweep through his whole map. It covers demons in Hollywood, the CIA, and lone gunmen. It also covers the Epstein case and what he frames as coordinated attacks on Christianity.

Dyer's method is connective; he reads movies, intelligence history, and crime stories as one text written by hidden authors. Carlson, who has moved steadily toward spiritual explanations of politics, is a receptive host. The claims are Dyer's system, not established findings, and the episode is best heard as a guided tour of an elaborate worldview. Its preservation value is real: few recordings state the occult-conspiracy reading of American life this completely, or to an audience this large, in the speakers' own voices.
